note: Both sets correctly bind PVC to both supply and waste pipe and capture the 1/4 in/ft minimum waste pipe slope with its 2009 IRC condition. Set B additionally captures the CEILING FINISH elevation of 10'-0 1/2" above the ground plane datum, which Set A omits despite including the other two datum elevations. Set A's elevation claims carry an explicit 'relative to GROUND PLANE' condition, which is slightly cleaner than B's 'height above ground plane' phrasing, but both are supported. No claims in either set are misread, misbound or invented.
remarks: The datum elevations (GROUND PLANE 0", FINISH FLOOR 2'-0 3/8", CEILING FINISH 10'-0 1/2", INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8") appear twice in the text layer (once per section view); both sets treat them as one fact each, which is appropriate. Splitting the single note 'ALL SUPPLY AND WASTE PIPE TO BE PVC PIPING' into supply-pipe and waste-pipe material claims is done identically by both sets and is a reasonable decomposition rather than duplication.
